pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks existing rows are 0 and 2 is rejected.
src/index.js default view 'open' with WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id; 'AC-2' test covers / and ?view=open.
'AC-3' test marks 3,1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
'AC-4' test expects all three items in id order, with only the done one marked.
nav() renders strong for the current view and links for the others; 'AC-5' asserts the exact nav HTML for all views and for /.
Object.hasOwn check returns 400 with no list; 'AC-6' covers Open, closed, empty and __proto__.
Empty table gives 'No items yet.' in every view; otherwise 'Nothing open.' or 'Nothing done yet.'; the 'AC-7' test covers all of these.

traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all; the 'AC-8' test checks the file. The checker script now accepts queries. The traffic test that proves the routes are actually requested was weakened (see finding).

findings.what: The assertion 'on a due minute hits /healthz and every listed route' was changed from toEqual(['/healthz', ...ROUTES]) to toBeDefined(), which can never fail. The test no longer proves that the traffic worker requests the listed routes, including the new query routes. The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none', which is false.
findings.fix: Restore expect(app.seen.map((s) => s.path)).toEqual(['/healthz', ...ROUTES]). The fakeApp already records pathname+search, so it works with query routes.

findings.what: The PR body claims no tests were loosened and says the only change to the traffic test was the fake app recording the query string. That is untrue: an assertion was gutted.
findings.fix: Restore the assertion and correct the PR body.

findings.what: Empty-table detection runs an extra COUNT query on every empty open or done view. This is fine functionally but adds a second query.
The README does not say that an unknown view answers 400, or that the default view is open. It does say '/ lists the open items'.
findings.fix: Optionally add a note that other view values answer 400.

lenses.note: The spec exists and its decisions are followed: the list opens on open items and the view is a query parameter. Nothing extra was added beyond relaxing the route checker, which the spec's traffic route needs.
All 8 acceptance items are implemented. AC-8's supporting traffic test was weakened.

The traffic.test.js assertion was loosened to toBeDefined(), which is a high finding. The vitest suite could not be run here because dependencies are not installed, so the new tests were read but not executed.
README updated; only a minor omission.
Handler logic is correct; prototype keys are guarded by Object.hasOwn; titles are escaped.

The view value is checked against an allowlist and the SQL fragment comes only from constants, so there is no injection. The title is HTML-escaped. No instructions were planted in the repository content.
The diff changes the HTML page, but there is no browser to view it; the nav structure is asserted in tests.
The diff changes the rendered page. No browser flow was run; the vitest suite could not run because dependencies are not installed.
The claim 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' is false.
